summary: Amplification Report for the Oren Brand Social Media Archetypes skill domain. Identifies 5 MISSED techniques not yet captured in workflows, 4 depth expansion candidates from existing workflows, 12 cross-expert stacking chains, and 6 non-obvious applications — including the design of a productized 'Archetype Arbitrage Service' that transforms raw concepts into structured brand strategies. Recommends 7 new workflows including a full-service Brand Architect Pipeline, a Boring Industry Excavation tool, a Two-Account Architect, and an Archetype-to-Revenue Bridge. This is the action plan for turning the Oren archetype system into a deployable, revenue-generating consulting product.
